Dram earned his bachelor's and master's degrees in architecture from the University of Tehran and completed two years of PhD coursework on digital design at the European Graduate School in Switzerland. name: Techable VC
description: 由前英伟达高管Amulya Vishwanath创立的早期风险投资基金,专注于物理AI领域投资,涵盖机器人、材料科学和生命科学,是英伟达首批女性高管spin-out创立的早期基金之一
description_en: An early-stage venture capital fund founded by former NVIDIA executive Amulya Vishwanath, focusing on physical AI investments across robotics, materials science, and life sciences, and one of the first funds launched by a female NVIDIA executive spin-out
why_matters: Vishwanath在英伟达领导机器人平台产品营销七年,拥有深厚的行业背景,她认为机器人行业目前处于'乐高时代',基础组件如执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准仍在重建阶段,这一观点对理解物理AI投资方向具有独特价值
why_matters_en: With seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA's robotics platforms, Vishwanath brings deep industry expertise. Her view that robotics is in its 'Lego era' with basic building blocks still being rebuilt offers unique insight for understanding physical AI investment direction
latest_news: Amulya Vishwanath作为创始人兼管理合伙人,正在通过Techable VC进行首轮投资支票,投资领域集中在物理AI的机器人、材料科学和生命科学
latest_news_en: Amulya Vishwanath, as founder and managing partner, is writing first checks through Techable VC, focusing investments on physical AI across robotics, materials science, and life sciences
source_title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet

evidence.quote: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA's robotics platforms

name: Aerium
description: 为工业制造商和分销商提供AI平台,集成现有系统数据,部署AI代理和机器学习模型来监控运营并自动化任务,解决协调和可见性问题
description_en: AI platform for industrial manufacturers and distributors that integrates existing system data and deploys AI agents and machine learning models to monitor operations and automate tasks, solving coordination and visibility problems
why_matters: 专注于工业制造领域的数据整合和自动化,通过AI代理帮助设备、特种化学品和金属零部件制造商应对员工退休和产能限制的挑战,目标成为下一代工业运营层
why_matters_en: Focuses on data integration and automation in industrial manufacturing, using AI agents to help equipment, specialty chemicals, and metal parts manufacturers address retiring staff and capacity constraints, aiming to become the next-generation industrial operating layer
latest_news: 2026年7月完成250万美元种子轮融资,由纽约Gutter Capital领投,已部署首批客户包括一家全球变压器制造商,计划年底前招聘前线部署工程师
latest_news_en: Closed $2.5 million USD seed round in July 2026 led by New York's Gutter Capital, deployed with first customers including a global transformer manufacturer, plans to hire forward-deployed engineers by end of 2026
source_title: McKinsey alumni raise $2.5 million USD to build AI for industrial manufacturers

evidence.quote: Aerium announced on Friday that it has secured $2.5 million USD ($3.6 million CAD) in seed funding to do just that. The funding came from New York City's Gutter Capital and undisclosed strategic angel investors in a simple agreement for future equity round that closed in July.
They also both worked as analysts in McKinsey's Toronto office, where they built software and agentic AI for industrial manufacturing clients.

name: Equal AI
description: 位于海得拉巴的来电显示初创公司，正寻求成长轮融资以扩大Truecaller市场份额
description_en: Hyderabad-based caller-ID startup seeking growth round to capture larger share of Truecaller's market
why_matters: 早期投资者对其成长轮表现出兴趣，估值目标高达10亿美元，定位为Truecaller在印度市场的竞争对手，显示出在成熟来电识别市场挑战现有巨头的潜力
why_matters_en: Early investor interest in growth round at valuations up to $1 billion, positioned as Truecaller competitor in Indian market, showing potential to challenge incumbent in mature caller-ID space
latest_news: 吸引早期投资者关注成长轮融资，估值目标高达10亿美元
latest_news_en: Has attracted early investor interest for a growth round at valuations of up to $1 billion
source_title: Ledger spyware scare raises supply-chain concerns across Asia

evidence.quote: Indian caller-ID startup Equal AI has attracted early investor interest for a growth round at a valuation of up to $1 billion as it pursues a larger share of Truecaller's market
